description: This file defines a React-like UI component named 'Home' using Lightning.js library. It composes subcomponents, manages internal state, and specifies a template for rendering weather-related UI panels and text elements.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A UI component for the home page displaying current weather conditions, highlights, and tips, implemented using Lightning.js component structure.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is mounted; it shows a welcome toast and sets the location.
